text:
Eve: Deploybot alerted p95 regression in canary for v3.5.0-rc2 at 09:47 UTC. Suggest hold.
Kai: Confirmed on dashboards, tail and p95 up ~15%. No error-rate change.
deploybot: ALERT: canary p95 threshold exceeded. Recommend pause + probe.
Eve: Pausing rollout: `/deploy pause v3.5.0-rc2 --scope=canary`
Lena: Quick check shows new kv-prefetch change in release notes. Can we flip feature flag on canary first?
Tom: Flag is `features.kv_prefetch`. I can toggle per-deployment. Flipping now for canary.
inc-bot: Incident created: INC-8100.
Kai: Early probes show p95 improving after flag flip (~11% drop). Running 15m synthetic to confirm.
Eve: Decision rule: if p95 back within 10% baseline after 15m -> continue with flag-off and staged rollout; else rollback to v3.4.x. Agreed?
Lena: Agreed. I'll open revert PR for the prefetch change and add KV-specific tests.
Tom: Flag flip held. Monitoring.
Eve: Will update internal status and queue a calm customer line.
